task_routes.fallback: Hyperliquid public info supplies venue-specific ETH historical funding over bounded windows (client ceiling now seven days; seven-day ETH response (168 rows) is retained as a normalized local replay artifact; exact HTTP wire bytes and redistribution rights are not established) and a current ETH OI snapshot; it does not provide historical OI or cross-venue context. Binance now has a bounded exact-symbol historical OI client, but this environment received HTTP 451 and must report it unavailable. DeFiLlama provides only provider-aggregate historical OI context; do not substitute it for instrument-level history. Bybit remains unavailable after HTTP 403. No retries, alternate hosts, proxies, or credentials. dYdX Indexer documents historical funding via read-only GET, but is excluded for this New York workspace under current dYdX Terms; no endpoint request was made, and its free entitlement/rate limits were not verified. Hive free discovery exposed historical funding and OI archives only as material one-credit calls; no material tool was invoked, and their upstream/terms/retention are unverified, so they are not eligible under the verified-free-only scope. Kraken public charts document funding and OI but remain unqueried until the project use scope is clarified against Kraken content terms; US applicability and a numeric chart request limit are also unverified. Crypto.com Exchange v1 now documents hourly historical funding and timestamped current ticker OI, but its US Exchange Terms restrict market-data use for others' benefit and redistribution/commercial use without written consent; do not route until Fin-Dex usage scope is established. Its ticker OI is current only, not a historical OI series.

cross_provider_rules.source_independence: A different API wrapper is not independent. DEX Screener reports its own blockchain-log indexer; DeFiLlama and Alternative.me have separate aggregated methodologies. DexPaprika is a distinct provider, but no pool-level evidence currently establishes its upstream collection as independent of DEX Screener. Verify whether a specific comparison shares upstream observations before marking CORROBORATED.
cross_provider_rules.request_budgets_and_caching: Use each referenced provider route contract. Each new client currently limits to one GET per command, a bounded timeout/body size, a short process-local cache, and no automatic retries.
cross_provider_rules.units_and_time: Preserve provider units and source timestamps. Retrieval timestamps are not metric observation timestamps. Normalize to UTC only when the source supplies a timestamp that can be safely interpreted.
cross_provider_rules.contradiction_handling: Retain conflicting values side by side. Reconcile identity, windows, unit, methodology, and provenance before a conclusion; otherwise label CONFLICTED or UNVERIFIED.
